31792-C.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), which distributes general grants to the provinces, adjusting expenditure and receipts and fixing the 2008 commitment amount for general grants at €1,189,090,000. It sets entry into force as of 1 June 2008 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Article 3: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet regarding general grants is fixed for the 2008 grant year at €1,189,090,000.

Artikel 3 Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) terzake van de algemene uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2008 vastgesteld op € 1 189 090 000.

31924-F.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) by adjusting appropriations, and sets the entry into force and the expenditure unit (thousands of euros). It also records the 2008 final budget settlement (slotwet) showing realised figures and final adjustments for the fund.
q: Whereas We have considered that a need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

31965-A.s: The bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Infrastructuurfonds), adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across infrastructure articles following the spring budget memorandum. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and provides that the amended statement takes effect from 1 June 2009, with retroactive effect where publication falls later.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2009 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

32395-C.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising total expenditure and receipts by about 115 million euro and setting new commitment amounts for the general, integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect on 1 June 2010, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The need has become apparent to amend the budget of expenditure and receipts of the provinciefonds for 2010.
Wij ... hebben goedgevonden ... de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begroting van de uitgaven en de ontvangsten van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2010

32565-D.s: The bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (economic structure enhancement fund) to reflect the autumn budget revision (Najaarsnota), changing expenditure and revenue lines across transport, environment, knowledge and innovation, and spatial planning. It sets the amended budget as a schedule to the law, effective from 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: Amendment of the 2010 budget statement of the Fonds economische structuurversterking (related to the autumn budget revision)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Fonds economische structuurversterking voor het jaar 2010 (wijziging samenhangende met de Najaarsnota)

33000-IIA.s: This bill fixes the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Staten-Generaal (IIA), setting appropriations and receipts for the Eerste Kamer, the allowances for members and former members of the Tweede Kamer and European Parliament, the Tweede Kamer's legislative and oversight apparatus, and inter-parliamentary activities. It also sets the effective date and the amounts in thousands of euros, without delegating rule-making power to the executive.
q: Article 1: The budget statement of the Staten-Generaal (IIA) for the year 2012 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van de Staten-Generaal (IIA) voor het jaar 2012 wordt vastgesteld.

33280-I.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the Royal Household (Begroting van de Koning), raising its expenditure by about 198 thousand euros through a first supplementary budget tied to the Spring Memorandum. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the change effective from 1 June 2012, with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Amendment of the budget statement belonging to the Budget of the King (I) for 2012 (amendment linked to the Spring Memorandum)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat behorende bij de Begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2012 (wijziging samenhangende met de Voorjaarsnota)

33605-H.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement of the BES fund (Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba) by adjusting revenue and expenditure figures in a final supplementary budget. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment retroactive to 31 December 2012.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the BES fund for the year 2012
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BES-fonds voor het jaar 2012

33640-I.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), raising the total by EUR 222 thousand in expenditure and EUR 418 thousand in receipts. The changes cover constitutional allowances after the change of monarch, a salary adjustment and reallocations between budget articles.
33640-I.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by the change of monarch on 30 April 2013 and the constitutional allowances set under the Wet financieel statuut van het koninklijk huis.
q: The current change provides for 2013 an adjustment of the constitutional allowances following the change of monarch, under the Financial Statute of the Royal House Act updated in 2008.

De huidige mutatie voorziet voor het jaar 2013 in de aanpassing van de grondwettelijke uitkeringen naar aanleiding van de troonswisseling, krachtens de in 2008 geactualiseerde Wet financieel statuut van het koninklijk huis.

33805-F.s: The bill amends the 2013 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) to reflect a supplementary budget adjustment, with expenditure and receipts changed in thousands of euros and effect from 1 December 2013. It sets the entry-into-force date and the retroactive effect rule for publication in the Staatsblad.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2013 is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2013 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33940-F.s: This bill amends the departmental budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) for 2014 through a first supplementary budget, raising expenditure and revenue lines by €9.294 million under article 01 on animal disease control. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 June 2014, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: is amended, as shown in the corresponding budget statement attached to this law
wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat

34350-J.s: This bill amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds (Delta Fund) through a second supplementary budget, adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across seven articles in thousands of euros. It also sets the effective date as 1 December of the budget year, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2015;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2015;

34475-B.s: This bill (slotwet) amends the 2015 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the final commitment amounts for the general grant, social domain integration grant and other grants in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date as the day after gazette publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
34475-B.j: The memorandum explains that the difference between the budgeted and realised payments arises because the provisional allotment factor is not yet final, so payments to municipalities can deviate from the budget.
q: The reason for the difference is that as long as the allotment factor 1 is not final, the amount of payments to municipalities can deviate from what is stated in the budget.

De reden van het verschil ligt in het feit dat zolang de uitkeringsfactor 1 niet definitief is de omvang van betalingen aan de gemeenten kan afwijken ten opzichte van wat in de begroting vermeld staat.

34485-A.s: This bill amends the 2016 departmental budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (Eerste suppletoire begroting), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and megaproject articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force from 1 June 2016 with retroactive effect where publication is late.

34620-J.s: This bill amends the Deltafonds budget statement for 2016 (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts across seven budget articles in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment to take effect from 1 December 2016, with retroactive effect if the State Gazette is published later.
q: The budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2016 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de bij deze wet behorende staat.

34845-A.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across road, rail, regional, waterway and mega-project articles. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and sets entry into force on 1 December 2017 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2017
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2017

34960-C.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and integration/decentralisation grants. It also fixes the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2018, with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Since We have considered that the need has arisen for an amendment to the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2018

35095-C.s: The bill amends the 2018 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), setting the commitment amounts for general, additional, integration and decentralisation grants and raising the total in figures. It takes effect on 1 December 2018, or retroactively if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the provinciefonds for the year 2018
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2018

35925-A.s: This bill sets the 2022 expenditure and revenue budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Mobiliteitsfonds, the transport infrastructure fund, in thousands of euros, and provides that it enters into force on 1 January 2022. The explanatory memorandum discusses budget shifts linked to nitrogen-related court rulings, DBFM contract accounting and Kustwacht costs, without creating new delegated powers.
q: The budget statement of the Mobility Fund, referred to in article 2 of the Mobility Fund Act, attached to this law, is established for the year 2022.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Mobiliteitsfonds, genoemd in artikel 2 van de Wet Mobiliteitsfonds, voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on 13 September 2021, that it had no remarks on the draft 2022 budget act for the Mobiliteitsfonds and recommended submitting it to the House of Representatives. The Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, sent a nader rapport on 20 September 2021 noting that some budget changes proved necessary and referring to annexes.

36250-I.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the King (Tweede suppletoire begroting) to adjust appropriations and receipts for the Royal Household, including repayment of the Princess of Orange's grondwettelijke uitkering in the same budget year. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the amendment effective from 1 December 2022.
q: From 2022 onward, the allowance of the Princess of Orange is repaid in the same budget year.
Met ingang van 2022 wordt de uitkering van de Prinses van Oranje teruggestort in hetzelfde begrotingsjaar.

36410-K.s: This bill fixes the 2024 departmental budget statement for the Defence Materiel Budget Fund, setting expenditure, commitments and receipts in thousands of euros across seven policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and does not alter oversight or judicial protections.
q: Cooperation with Defence's innovation partners gets a firm foundation and continuity through this.
De samenwerking met de innovatiepartners van Defensie krijgt hierdoor een stevige grondslag en continuïteit.

36600-J.s: The bill formally establishes the 2025 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds, setting expenditure, commitment and revenue amounts in thousands of euros for the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management. It takes effect on 1 January of the budget year, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement for the Deltafonds attached to this law, referred to in article 7.22a of the Water Act, is established for the year 2025.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat inzake het Deltafonds, genoemd in artikel 7.22a van de Waterwet, voor het jaar 2025 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering had no remarks on the draft Deltafonds budget bill for 2025 and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets need amendment and refers to annexed changes, without substantive reply to objections.

36625-C.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general-grant commitment amount to €3,554,618,000 and setting decentralisation grant commitments at €399,727,000. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2024.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is changed for grant year 2024 to €3,554,618,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2024 gewijzigd in € 3.554.618.000.

36725-B.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by adding about 1.36 billion euros in commitments and expenditure and sets the 2025 commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the integration and decentralisation grants. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2025.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2025

36725-XXII.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget of the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning (XXII) and the agency budget for that ministry, through a first supplementary budget with changes in commitments, expenditure and receipts. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 June 2025.
36725-XXII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by project delays, complexity and a Raad van State ruling on nature protection law, with no delegation or new powers involved.
q: The planned projects for 2025 have been delayed due to complexity and the Council of State's ruling on European nature protection law.
De geplande projecten voor 2025 zĳn vertraagd vanwege complexiteit en de uitspraak van de Raad van State omtrent het Europese natuurbeschermingsrecht.

36850-C.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general allocation commitment to €3,714,685,000 and the decentralisation-grant commitments to €396,594,000 with effect from 1 December 2025. It is a second supplementary budget adjusting the appropriations and entering into force retroactively.
q: Amendment of the 2025 budget statement of the provinciefonds
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het provinciefonds voor het jaar 2025

36915-A.s: This bill amends the 2026 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (Mobiliteitsfonds A) through a first supplementary budget, adjusting commitments and expenditure across infrastructure articles such as road, rail, waterways and mega-projects. It sets budget units in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 June 2026.
36915-A.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by reference to realistic re-estimation of expenditure, reallocations within the fund and unforeseen cost increases, without claiming new executive powers.
q: In the first supplementary budget 2026, as in previous budget documents, the expenditure estimates for all articles were critically reviewed.
Bij de eerste suppletoire begroting 2026 is er net zoals de vorige begrotingsstukken kritisch gekeken naar de uitgavenramingen op alle artikelen
